facts.business: Lancor Holdings Limited is engaged in property development, primarily residential properties and plotted land development, with a focus on redevelopment of city properties in Chennai and Sriperumbudur.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Three city redevelopment projects over next 24-30 months will yield turnover of over Rs.492 crores
Town & Country Harmonia Pavilion apartments construction expected to be completed by November or December 2026
Balance flats in Harmonia to be marketed by March 2027

key_risks: Geopolitical tensions affecting Middle East remittances and Indian economy
Uncertainty regarding new Chennai airport location impacting Sriperumbudur demand
Slow offtake in Harmonia apartment format (first-time offering)
Poor traction for Harmonia Duplex Villas
Delays in Expressway to Bangalore construction
High investment requirement for commercial properties limiting entry
Tamil Nadu Apartment Ownership Act not implemented affecting redevelopment approvals
Dependence on private housing societies (30-35 years old) for redevelopment supply
Reliance on private debt funds and bank finance amid economic uncertainty
facts.related_party_note: Preferential issue of 33,33,330 warrants to promoters Mr. R V Shekar (Promoter & Managing Director) and Mrs. Shyamala Shekar (Promoter) for aggregate issue size of Rs. 9,99,99,900 at Rs. 30 per warrant (including Rs. 28 premium). 25% upfront received, balance 75% payable on exercise.
